tools.name: extract_document_text
tools.description:
Extract OCR text from PDF or image document. Always call this first.

Args:
    key: S3 key for the document (e.g., 'uploads/receipt.pdf')

Returns:
    JSON with md5_hash, input_file, and ocr_files array

tools.name: classify_document_type
tools.description:
Classify document type (receipt, invoice, EOB, etc.). Call after extracting text.

Args:
    md5_hash: Document hash from extract_document_text

Returns:
    Document type as string (e.g., 'receipt', 'invoice')

tools.name: extract_issuer_name
tools.description:
Extract the company/merchant that issued the document.

Args:
    md5_hash: Document hash from extract_document_text

Returns:
    Issuer name as string (e.g., 'Home Depot')

tools.name: extract_service_date
tools.description:
Extract the service date from the document.

Args:
    md5_hash: Document hash from extract_document_text

Returns:
    Service date as string (e.g., '2025-09-29')

tools.name: extract_issuer_address
tools.description:
Extract the business address from the document as it appears.

Args:
    md5_hash: Document hash from extract_document_text

Returns:
    Business address as string (e.g., '123 Main St\nAnytown, CA 90210')

tools.name: extract_line_items
tools.description:
Extract itemized line items from receipt or invoice.

Args:
    md5_hash: Document hash from extract_document_text

Returns:
    JSON array of line items with description, quantity, unit_price, and total for each item
